## Hermes digest – hf-models
08:10 Europe/Athens → Talk room of profile hf-models.

Hugging Face API: the 50 trending text-generation models and the 50 trending GGUF models. Keeps models created today or yesterday (Athens) that are GGUF or have more than 100 downloads; image, audio and video models are skipped. Template only, no LLM. Nothing new = no message.

Manual run = dry run: the result is returned, nothing is posted. Another workflow can call this one with {"dry_run": false|true, "use_llm": false, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The workflow is its own error workflow: a failed scheduled run posts one line to the room. Credentials are created by n8n/scripts/hermes-digests-setup.sh.
